author: reek
body: Proves fast mana works: a free mana artifact (Mox Ruby, cost 0) in hand is played out and tapped for mana the SAME turn. ai-play-mana-artifacts casts it before the tap step, then ai-tap-mana-sources taps it, so the pool holds one red mana with no lands in play -- the turn-one Mox the deck builder now runs actually accelerates.
